title: feat(lint): refuse a transferBehavior cascade the Change Owner action can never offer

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg8ZBQe4UHadd2fGHGeWRW9V)_

repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbdHk3orAeensH6EzS

Fixes #36714
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: follow-up #35769 (row 7178935378: skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md, the three lint refusals)

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化:应用作者在命令行校验、构建或检查应用时,若关联字段声明了「变更负责人时连带转移」而这种转移永远不会发生(父对象不提供变更负责人、经对象扩展加到不支持它的对象上、或子对象的接口不允许更新),现在会直接报错并写明怎么改;最终用户无感,运行时行为不变。
- 为什么做:数据模型专区「声明了就要生效」的收尾,替变更负责人连带转移功能补上作者期的提醒。
- 出错会怎样:若判断有误,作者的应用会在命令行校验时被误拦,改字段或对象即可通过;不影响已部署的应用和工作室保存,可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

A `transferBehavior: 'cascade'` that the Change Owner endpoint can never offer used to parse silently (ADR-0049, declared but not enforced). One new `@objectstack/lint` rule, `validateTransferCascades`, refuses each of the card's three cases at `error`, with the fix in the hint:

| Rule id | Case | Verdict from (spec, `@objectstack/spec/data`) |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `transfer-cascade-parent-without-change-owner` | 1: the reference points at a parent in the stack that does not offer Change Owner | `resolveUserActionTransfer` + `transferIneligibilityReason` (what the endpoint's `changeOwnerOffReason` asks) |
| `transfer-cascade-extension-child-ineligible` | 2: an `objectExtensions[].fields` field cascades onto an object that cannot take a cascade | `transferCascadeIneligibilityReason` (what `refuseIneligibleTransferCascades` and `transferCascadeRelations` ask) |
| `transfer-cascade-child-update-unexposed` | 3: the child's `enable` block does not serve `update` | `apiExposureDenialReason` (`canServeApiOperation` is its boolean face, the exposure filter in `transferCascadeRelations`) |

- `packages/lint/src/validate-transfer-cascades.ts`: the walk only. Objects are judged as served (`objectsAsServed`, every extension field folded in), since `transferCascadeRelations` reads the registered, merged definitions. An object the stack does not declare is skipped on either side. Only single-value `lookup` / `master_detail` fields are judged; off-type, multi-value and `sys_`-parent cascades stay the field parse's refusals and are not reported twice.
- Registered in `authoring-rules.ts`: `gating`, all three commands, `surfaces: CLI_ONLY` with a `surfaceReason` (see Acceptance notes). Exported from the barrel (rule ids included), and the three ids have `os explain` entries in `rule-explanations.ts` (inserted, not reordered).
- `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.transfer-cascade-never-offered-refused.ts`: the ADR-0087 ledger entry `check:adr-0087-registration` requires for a `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` changeset. It is a data file, not a schema change.
- Docs: one sentence in `content/docs/api/data-api.mdx` beside the existing multi-value refusal, and the CLI transcripts' author-time rule count 79 → 80 (`check:docs-transcript-drift`).
- Changeset: `@objectstack/lint` minor, `@objectstack/spec` minor (the kind is `narrowed`).

Mechanism assumptions measured at `origin/main` 98bda0ac before code: A1 holds (the predicates are exported from `@objectstack/spec/data`; lint imports them the way `validate-managed-api-methods.ts` does, no third copy). A2: `error`, following `validateManagedApiMethods` (a declaration decidable from the stack that the runtime silently drops) and the parse's own refusal of the declaring object's half. A3 holds (`child.enable` through the exposure predicate). A4: the two `validate-predicate-path-refs.test.ts` pins count form predicates, not registry entries; nothing moved.

Files to read first, by risk:
1. `packages/lint/src/validate-transfer-cascades.ts` — `validateTransferCascades`, the served-object lookup and the `sys_` / not-declared skips.
2. `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts` — the new entry's tier and `surfaceReason`.
3. `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.transfer-cascade-never-offered-refused.ts`.

## Tests

`packages/lint/src/validate-transfer-cascades-36714.test.ts`: every fixture is a full `ObjectSchema` / `ObjectExtensionSchema` parse, so each refusal is one the parse lets through. Each case is refused with its rule, severity, `where`, `path` and the reason fragment its message names; each eligible shape passes (an eligible parent, a parent outside the stack, a `sys_` parent, an eligible extension target, a target outside the stack, `update` served); the `packages[]` artifact shape is read; and the `fieldPatches` arm is pinned as refused by the schema.

<details><summary>Local runs at 3e1fa4a6 (lint, spec, ablation)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test`: Test Files 236 passed (236), Tests 9648 passed, 5 skipped (VERDICT command-exit 0).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck`: VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: Test Files 894 passed, 1 skipped (895), Tests 28417 passed (VERDICT command-exit 0).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run test/migrate-meta-engine-guidance.test.ts`: 3 passed.
- Ablation (rule committed first): `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the walk's `for (const site of cascadeSites(stack))` with an empty loop, x0 -> x1 on disk; the card's test file went 15 failed, 9 passed (24). Every refusal case red, every pass case green. Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The `Clause-②:` line carries the `(narrowing)` arm (body and changeset, commit 8737482b): Check Changeset reads `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` beside a clause line without the arm as a contradiction. The claim's `Clause-②: no` was copied first, at 3e1fa4a6.
- Premise, partly narrower than written: case 2's `fieldPatches` arm cannot occur. A field patch carries display properties only (`label`, `description`, `inlineHelpText`, `placeholder`), and `ObjectExtensionSchema` refuses `transferBehavior` there as an unrecognized key, so the rule walks extension `fields` only; a test pins the refusal.
- Not on the runtime publish gate yet (`surfaces: CLI_ONLY`): the door's objects are served definitions carrying the injected `owner_id` as a declared field, which the eligibility predicate reads (its `readonly`, and on an external object whether it is declared). Crossing owes that measurement or a read-back to the authored shape, as `lintDuplicateFieldLabels` does. Until then a Studio or MCP save of these shapes still passes. The runtime stays safe.
- Boundary: a cascade on a field an object declares itself, where only an extension makes the served object ineligible, is not reported as case 2 (the card scopes case 2 to extension fields; the object's own half is the parse's).
- File surface: the ADR-0087 ledger entry under `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/` is outside the claim's listed surface. `check:adr-0087-registration` requires it for `narrowed`; it changes no schema and no runtime.
- First-party exposure: zero. No example app, platform object, skill or docs sample declares a cascade.
- Other open PRs that add an author-time rule (#37354, #37371) move the same transcript count; whichever lands second gets a one-number docs conflict or a `check:docs-transcript-drift` red.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-transfer-cascades-36714.test.ts` prints 24 passed.
